interpretation: the ratio cancels common-mode variation; it is much tighter when machine state moves both arms together and has no advantage on a quiet machine, so a sitting in which it is not tighter is consistent with the mechanism rather than a failure of it
purpose: whether the absolute cost or the ratio survives being measured again on the same machine
scope_note: one sitting is one machine state, so this is a lower bound on the variation a later reproduction sees, not an estimate of it
